name: RPG Walk Test
description: Integration test of the rpg mod on the rpg_plus game (its rpg_demo_game world): real WASD/E key events walk the hero, collide, read a sign, turn an NPC, go through a door teleport, flip events by a story flag, fight a battle that returns to the same cell with the win flag set. A pickup the suite adds to the village through its own map_events file is picked up and must stay gone after leaving the map and coming back, and after a save is loaded. Activated by --itest=rpg_walk with --game=rpg_plus --new (the prologue is clicked through first); --shots=<dir> saves screenshots (windowed runs only).
